WITNESS STATEMENT
Taken by: Detective S. Ramos, Marion County PD
Witness: Alicia M. Kemp, DOB 09/12/1991
Date/Time Taken: March 15, 2024, 14:30
Location: MCPD HQ, Interview Room B

Q: Please describe in your own words what happened on the night of March 14.
A: I was walking home from the Linden Tap Room. I had two beers, maybe three. It was around 11:30, maybe a little before. A guy came up from behind me — I didn't hear him until he was right there. He grabbed my purse strap and pulled. I let go. I think he also grabbed my phone out of my hand but it was so fast.

Q: Did you see the person's face?
A: Not really. He had a hood up. I saw the side of his face for maybe a second when he turned to run. Light-skinned. Maybe Hispanic or white. I'm not sure.

Q: At the show-up that night, you told the officer you weren't 100% sure. Is that still your position?
A: Yes. It looked like him. The build was right. But I couldn't swear to it in court.

Q: What did the person take from you?
A: My iPhone, a black wallet, and I had about $300 in cash because I'd just hit the ATM.

Q: Anything else you remember?
A: He was wearing a grey hoodie, I'm pretty sure. Dark pants. I told the officer that when I called.

[Statement read back to witness, signed at 15:02 by Alicia M. Kemp.]
